title: From Symbol to Meaning: Ontological and Philosophical Reflections on Large Language Models in Information Systems Engineering
reasoning: The paper includes substantial sections dedicated to epistemology and ethics, specifically discussing the 'ontological ethics of responsibility,' 'epistemic justice,' and the moral agency of human beings in the context of AI-driven systems. It frames LLMs as 'epistemic agents' and evaluates their role through various philosophical and ethical frameworks.
